from oa_labor_contract c left join oa_labor_contract_template t on t.template_id = c.template_id left join sys_dept employee_dept on employee_dept.dept_id = c.employee_dept_id left join sys_dept shop_dept on shop_dept.dept_id = c.shop_dept_id
